judged_text: `refreshTokenResponse.data.refresh_token` is read on the safeParse result without a success check in the branch path — when the schema-parsed result is a ZodSafeParseError, data is undefined, and additionally assigning a fake refresh_token ("refresh_token") on a ZodParsedType object can throw a read-only error in zod. On any token response lacking refresh_token in credential-sync mode, this line throws a TypeError (reading 'refresh_token' of undefined) or an illegal-assignment error, crashing the refresh path with a 500 instead of the intended error message; no test in the diff exercises a response without refresh_token, so the crash ships silently.
